chose: The owner's guard on #3521 is held by the record itself, not by convention: every /2 event names its author (`by`: owner, agent or home), and the step refuses any other than EVENT_AUTHORS gives its kind. The owner sets the topic, gives points, flags, withdraws, green-lights and approves a preview; the agent writes versions and notes; home measures a version's audio. Notes come only after the green light and an approval, naming at least one rule the owner approved, and never on a turn whose words the record doesn't hold. A flag names the version the owner heard and lands on it or is refused, so a late flag on v1's k1 is never v2's. A flag of several kinds is answered kind by kind (an answer names the kinds it answers, all by default) and is answered once every kind is, so a whole conversation too quiet and unhuman can be conditioned and rewritten in one version. A second approval of a rule names the approval it moves. A record lifted from /1 says how many of its events were lifted; only those replay under /1's rules, each must be one a lift makes (read back through /1's frozen schema), and every later event is held to /2's, so a lifted record still flagged needs a measured length for any new version it green-lights.
options: Authors, the flag's version, per-kind answers and the lift's boundary held by the step (chosen)
The owner's guard by convention, the agent writing what the owner may
A flag of several kinds answered only by an answer every kind allows
A lifted record replayed wholly under /1's rules
gray: Who may write each kind of event, how a flag of several kinds is answered, and which rules a lifted record keeps are what the owner meets in Studio and in what home will accept; the review found the record left each open.
undo: Drop `by` and EVENT_AUTHORS, the flag event's `version`, the answers' `kinds` and the lift's `through` from conversation.ts; records written since would then carry fields /2 no longer reads.
